fields.summary_ko.0: Microsoft (MSFT) beat results with Q1 revenue of $9.23 billion (19% YoY increase) and operating income of $4.59 billion (21% increase), with Azure growing 48%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Microsoft's Agents and Infra segment remaining performance obligation (RPO) reached $67.7 billion, up 73% YoY, demonstrating strong AI demand and indicating AI does not replace products.
